DeepSeekApiIntegration.Compatibility: OpenAI API Compatible (drop-in replacement for OpenAI SDKs)

Model.Description: DeepSeek-V3 model. Optimized for general chat, coding, and tool calling.
DeepSeek-R1 model. Features chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning before answering.

SpecialFields.Field: Returns the CoT reasoning process. In streaming mode, it appears in `delta.reasoning_content`.

Limitations.Limitation: Tool calling is not officially supported or recommended.
System prompts are supported but may not strictly adhere to complex instructions compared to deepseek-chat.
Temperature should generally be kept low (e.g., 0.6) for best reasoning.

IntegrationNotes.Note: Because it is OpenAI-compatible, you can use standard OpenAI client libraries in Python, Node.js, Kotlin, etc., by just changing the base URL and API key.

For DeepSeek-R1 (reasoner), the `reasoning_content` is a proprietary extension to the OpenAI schema. If using strongly-typed clients, you may need to extend the Message/Delta models to capture this field.
DeepSeek provides context caching automatically for repeated prefixes, which significantly reduces costs for long prompts.
Max output tokens for reasoner includes BOTH the reasoning_content and the final content. Usually, up to 8K tokens output.
